# Whats Up Nails Fairy Powder: Multi-Chrome Mirror Effect Nail Pigment

Transform your manicure into a shimmering, color-shifting finish. This Fairy Powder Magic Color Shifting Pigment delivers a multi-chrome mirror effect with pink, gold, and green tones that shift as you move your hand.

## Features That Make the Difference

Each jar holds 1 gram of ultra-fine, high-quality mica powder. Apply it over gel polish or regular polish (with a compatible top coat) to achieve a smooth, reflective finish. Because this powder is dense, a small amount covers an entire nail.

## Benefits for Your Manicure

Achieve a salon-style mirror finish at home without specialized training. A little goes a long way, so one jar can cover many manicures. The powder works with both gel and regular polish, giving you flexibility in your routine. It also suits nail stamping for layered designs.

## Get the Best Results

For the full effect, use a glossy top coat. Thin layers and gentle buffing create the smoothest finish. Black base polish intensifies the color shift.

## Add Fairy Magic to Your Nails

Ready to add a mesmerizing shine to your nails? Add this pigment to your cart today and start creating your own color-shifting mirror manicure.
